info.name: Microsoft Azure AccessControlClient AccessConnector Operator API
Microsoft Azure Get A List Of All Operators

params.name: skip
params.description: An optional parameter for how many entries to skip, for pagination purposes. The default value is 0

params.name: top
params.description: An optional parameter for how many entries to return, for pagination purposes. The default will return the entire list.

items.docs: This endpoint gets a list of all operators
